NuGet dependencies are declared centrally but not locked (no packages.lock.json)

Server-side failures returned as 400 with error text in deprecated Warning header instead of a structured error body

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Maintainability: provider switch on DataSourceType repeated three times and error-logging block duplicated
findings.recommendation: Introduce a per-provider strategy (e.g. IDbProvider with BuildConnectionString/CreateConnection/ResetScript) resolved once, and collapse the two identical LogError/throw blocks into a single outer catch.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Functional suitability: reset commits only when 0 rows deleted and rolls back otherwise, yet reports success
findings.recommendation: Commit the transaction on successful execution regardless of the deleted-row count (roll back only on exception), and add a test asserting deletes persist.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Reliability: fatal startup exception is logged but the process exits with code 0
findings.recommendation: Return a non-zero exit code (e.g. Environment.ExitCode = 1 or rethrow) after logging so hosts/orchestrators detect the failed start.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Unused Logger property created in TestingService

evidence.excerpt: this.Logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger(GetType()); ... protected ILogger Logger { get; }

findings.recommendation: Remove the unused logger dependency or use it to log service-level outcomes.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Project folders misspelled 'PilotUtiltyApi' while namespaces/projects use 'PilotUtilityApi'
findings.recommendation: Rename the src/test folders to PilotUtilityApi.* to match namespaces and project names, and fix the 'Instatiate' typos.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Several XML doc comments are inaccurate (copy-paste returns text, wrong usage examples)

evidence.excerpt: /// A read only list of all DTO objects from the category table, or null if no objects exist.

findings.recommendation: Correct the HealthCheck <returns> text and the <example> snippets so they match the real extension targets (WebApplicationBuilder/WebApplication).

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: IDisposable connection and transaction are not wrapped in using (CS-CS-04)

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();

findings.recommendation: Use 'await using' declarations for the DbConnection and DbTransaction (and OpenAsync/BeginTransactionAsync) so they are disposed even if an exception occurs before the inner try.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: BuildServiceProvider called during service registration (ASP0000), creating a second container
findings.standard: C# coding conventions / ASP.NET Core analyzers
findings.recommendation: Read IApplicationConfiguration from builder.Configuration (or use IOptions/IConfigureOptions) instead of building an intermediate service provider.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No CI pipeline builds and tests every push/PR; build and test are manual only
findings.standard: SLSA v1.0 Requirements (scripted build on a hosted build platform)
findings.recommendation: Add a CI workflow (e.g. .github/workflows/ci.yml) that runs dotnet restore, build and test on every push and pull request, and make it a required status check on main.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No documented release process (tagging, changelog, publish step)

evidence.excerpt: 4. Increase the version numbers in any examples files and the README.md to the new version that this Pull Request would represent.
1. Ensure any install or build dependencies are removed before the end of the layer when doing a build.

findings.recommendation: Document a release procedure (version bump in Directory.Build.props, Git tag vX.Y.Z, changelog entry, build/publish step) and replace the boilerplate container-layer step in CONTRIBUTING.md, which does not apply to this repo.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Inconsistent version sources: assembly version 1.0.0 vs documented API version 0.1.1
findings.recommendation: Keep a single source of truth for the version (Directory.Build.props) and derive the OpenAPI/documented version from it so bumps are consistent and meaningful.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Branching model not documented; review rule exists only as text with no visible enforcement

evidence.excerpt: 5. You may merge the Pull Request in once you have the sign-off of two other developers

findings.recommendation: Document the branching model (e.g. trunk-based with short-lived feature branches into protected main) and enforce it with branch protection/rulesets requiring reviews and passing CI.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No build provenance, signing or reproducible-build settings
findings.recommendation: Once CI exists, generate build provenance attestations (e.g. actions/attest-build-provenance) and enable deterministic builds (ContinuousIntegrationBuild, RestorePackagesWithLockFile).

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No automated or scheduled dependency updates (no Dependabot/Renovate config)
findings.recommendation: Add .github/dependabot.yml with the nuget ecosystem (and github-actions once CI exists) on a weekly schedule.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No SECURITY.md or vulnerability-reporting process

evidence.excerpt: reported by contacting the project team at MikelLooper@gmail.com.

findings.recommendation: Add a SECURITY.md describing supported versions and a private reporting channel (e.g. GitHub private vulnerability reporting); the only contact today is for Code of Conduct issues.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No changelog or release notes

evidence.excerpt: 2. Update the README.md with details of changes to the interface

findings.recommendation: Add a CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog format) and require an entry per PR in CONTRIBUTING.md.

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: NuGet dependencies are declared centrally but not locked (no packages.lock.json)
findings.recommendation: Set <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile> in Directory.Build.props, commit the generated packages.lock.json files, and restore with --locked-mode in builds.

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: Deploy-specific config and credential fields live in committed, environment-named appsettings files
findings.recommendation: Remove hosts, user names and password fields from committed appsettings files and supply them per deploy via environment variables (e.g. Application__DataSources__0__Password) or a secret store; keep only non-deploy-specific defaults in appsettings.json.

findings.subject: Application Design
findings.title: App writes and manages its own rolling log files instead of only streaming to stdout
findings.recommendation: Drop the Serilog File sink (or enable it only in a local-dev override) and rely on the Console/OTLP streams, leaving routing and retention to the execution environment; also remove the committed files under src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web/logs/ from the repository.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Committed OpenAPI spec does not match implemented routes and DTOs
findings.recommendation: Regenerate docs/PilotUtilityApi_v1.json from the running app (or at build time) so the path is /v1/testing/reset, the show-details parameter reflects [BindRequired], and AboutResponse includes the optional applicationConfiguration property; add a CI diff check to keep it in sync.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Inconsistent URL structure: URL-segment versioning mixed with unversioned routes and a verb-style action path

evidence.excerpt: ApiVersionReader.Combine(new HeaderApiVersionReader("api-version"), new QueryStringApiVersionReader(), new UrlSegmentApiVersionReader());

findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines - URL structure (DO)
findings.recommendation: Pick one versioning mechanism (Azure guidelines use the api-version query parameter rather than a path segment) and model actions as resource operations (e.g. POST /testing:reset or a resource noun) instead of a verb path segment.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Server-side failures returned as 400 with error text in deprecated Warning header instead of a structured error body

evidence.excerpt: Response.Headers.Append("Warning", response.ErrorMessage ?? "An error occurred"); return BadRequest();

findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines - HTTP status codes / error handling (DO)
findings.recommendation: Return 5xx for service/data-store failures (4xx only for client errors) and put a consistent error object (code + message, e.g. ProblemDetails) in the body with an error-code header, rather than using the deprecated Warning header.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No authentication is configured and every controller is marked [AllowAnonymous]
findings.recommendation: Register an authentication scheme (e.g. JWT bearer via a vetted IdP, or API key for this utility API), add UseAuthentication/UseAuthorization, and remove the class-level [AllowAnonymous] from TestingController.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Destructive POST /v1/testing/reset and configuration-revealing /about?show-details have no authorization
findings.recommendation: Protect the reset endpoint with [Authorize(Policy = ...)] restricted to an admin/test role (and disable it outside test environments), and require authorization for show-details=true; keep only /healthcheck anonymous.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header is set; the pipeline also serves Swagger UI and Scalar HTML pages
findings.standard: OWASP Content Security Policy Cheat Sheet
findings.recommendation: Add security-header middleware (for example NetEscapades.AspNetCore.SecurityHeaders or a small custom middleware) that sets `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` on API responses. Use a looser policy only for the Swagger/Scalar UI routes.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is not set

evidence.excerpt: public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp) ... no security-header middleware registered

findings.recommendation: Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` to every response from the same security-header middleware.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No clickjacking protection (no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors)
findings.recommendation: Send `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and/or the CSP directive `frame-ancestors 'none'` on all responses, including the Swagger and Scalar UI pages.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development (the condition is inverted), and the launch profile listens on HTTP only
findings.recommendation: Call `UseHttpsRedirection()` (with `UseHsts()`) in every environment except Development, or reject HTTP at the edge. Also add an HTTPS URL to the launch profile.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: Placeholder and mis-arranged tests pass without asserting the behavior they name
findings.recommendation: Remove the Assert.Pass placeholder or replace it with real Domain model tests, fix the null-message controller test to actually return a null ErrorMessage and assert the default Warning header value, and replace 'DoesNotThrow' constructor tests with assertions on observable behavior.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No CI pipeline runs the test suite on each change

evidence.excerpt: After creating or updating tests, verify all unit tests can run successfully. - Run the relevant test projects.

findings.recommendation: Add a CI workflow (e.g. GitHub Actions) that runs 'dotnet test' with coverage collection on every push and pull request, and require it to pass before merge.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: User-facing correlation ID is a random GUID that is not linked to the OpenTelemetry trace ID

evidence.excerpt: public static LoggingCorrelation GetLoggingCorrelation() { return new LoggingCorrelation(); }

findings.recommendation: Derive the correlation ID from Activity.Current?.TraceId (falling back to HttpContext.TraceIdentifier), so the ID shown to callers can be used to find the trace in Tempo and the related logs in Loki.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No SLOs or SLIs are documented in the repository
findings.recommendation: Document target SLIs, such as availability and p95 latency from http.server.request.duration, along with SLO thresholds (for example in docs/ or the README), so the exported metrics can be alerted on.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No SBOM or third-party license inventory present

evidence.excerpt: 34 PackageVersion entries; no sbom.json, *.cdx.json, *.spdx.json or THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES file found in repository

findings.recommendation: Generate a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM (e.g. via CycloneDX dotnet tool or Microsoft sbom-tool) as part of the build and publish it with releases.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No retry with backoff for transient database failures
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded exponential-backoff retry for transient connection errors (e.g. a Polly resilience pipeline, SqlRetryLogicProvider, or Npgsql retry), applied to the connect step and the idempotent reset.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No circuit breaker protecting calls to the database dependency
findings.recommendation: Add a circuit breaker (e.g. Polly CircuitBreaker strategy in a shared resilience pipeline) around database access so a degraded DB fails fast instead of tying up requests for the full connect timeout.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Project folder names misspelled (PilotUtiltyApi.*) and inconsistent with csproj names, namespaces and README structure
findings.recommendation: Rename the src/ and test/ folders to PilotUtilityApi.* to match project names and namespaces (dotnet_style_namespace_match_folder is enabled), then update the .sln paths and README.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Database provisioning and secret/environment configuration steps are not documented

evidence.excerpt: One of the following databases: SQL Server ... PostgreSQL (version 12+)
For local development and testing, the following User Secret can be used:

findings.standard: Maintainability fallback rubric (onboarding prerequisites and environment documentation)
findings.recommendation: Document how to create the NorthWind/northwind database and the test tables/schema, give the `dotnet user-secrets set` commands, and show environment-variable overrides (e.g. Application__DataSources__0__Password) instead of editing appsettings.json.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Stale references: solution lists a missing .runsettings file and CONTRIBUTING links a non-existent README section
findings.recommendation: Add the .runsettings file or remove it from Solution Items, and either add a 'Copilot Customization' README section or point CONTRIBUTING at .github/copilot-instructions.md.
